info.title: Caley
info.description: Caley's JSON API: calendars, contacts, mail and OpenPGP keys.

delete.summary: Deletes the user with all their data (accounts, caches, mail files) and ends the session.

password keeps the stored one. PUT is the same.

Adds (no `account_id`) or updates a CalDAV account after testing the connection; an empty
password keeps the stored one. PUT is the same.

put.summary:
Adds (no `account_id`) or updates a mail account; PUT is the same. A JMAP account is saved only once its server
has answered its session with the account's sign-in; one that signs in at the server (`oauth`) and is to be
authorized is saved when the server's sign-in comes back (`authorize`).

post.summary:
Adds (no `account_id`) or updates a mail account; PUT is the same. A JMAP account is saved only once its server
has answered its session with the account's sign-in; one that signs in at the server (`oauth`) and is to be
authorized is saved when the server's sign-in comes back (`authorize`).

400.description: password required for new account, or the JMAP server refused the sign-in or could not be reached (plain text)

(`Content-Security-Policy: sandbox …`); anything else is `application/octet-stream`, `attachment`.

get.summary:
The message's MIME source, as the reader reads it (sinter-mail's `mail.mime`). With `omit`, a cut message: the
bodies of large attachments left out, where they were in `Mail-Holes` (JSON, `[{ start, end, size }]`, offsets of
the whole message, `size` decoded). Without it the whole message, which answers a `Range` (one range of bytes,
`If-Range` with its `ETag`), so a cut body is fetched when it is opened. Both carry the whole message's `ETag`.

parameters.name: omit
parameters.description:
leave out the bodies of attachments larger than this many bytes (encoded): a cut message (sinter-mail's
"Large attachments: cut messages"), the cuts in the `Mail-Holes` header. Inline images count from 512 KiB
(or this, if larger).

200.description: the cached .eml, or with `omit` the cut message

206.description: the range of the whole message a `Range` asked for

404.description: no such account or no cached source (plain text)

416.description: a range outside the message (plain text)

get.summary:
An image of a message: an inline part by Content-ID, or a remote image of a whitelisted origin.
Only PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and AVIF (sniffed from the bytes) are served; anything else, an

1×1 transparent GIF.

get.summary:
The live updates of the signed-in user (server-sent events; a `heartbeat` comment every 30 s).
Starts the user's CalDAV and email sync tasks.

200.description: Server-sent events, each an `event:` name with a `data:` line. With data `1` (re-fetch): `events_refetch` (/api/events), `calendars_changed` (/api/calendars), `contacts_refetch` (/api/contacts), `accounts_changed` (the email accounts), `vault_changed` (/api/pgp/vault: the vault, its keys or its devices, e.g. a pending device approved). With JSON data: `event_updated` `{account_id, uid, calendar_href, event?: EventJson}`, `event_removed` `{account_id, uid, calendar_href}`, `contact_updated` `{account_id, uid, addressbook_href, contact?: ContactJson}`, `contact_removed` `{account_id, uid, addressbook_href}`, `emails_refetch` `{account_id, mailbox}`, `email_updated` `{account_id, uid: number, mailbox, flags: string[]}`, `email_removed` `{account_id, uid: number, mailbox}`, `new_email` `{account_id, uid: number, mailbox, from: string|null, subject: string|null}`, `mailboxes_changed` `{account_id}`, `sync_started` and `sync_completed` `{account_id, mailbox}`.

400.description: a required field is missing, no events in the file, or more than 1,000 events (plain text)

502.description: the CalDAV server refused to create the new calendar (plain text)

400.description: no file, no importable events in it, or more than 1,000 events (plain text)

put.summary: Stores a device's subscription (again, for an endpoint the user had: its keys may be new).

400.description: not an https endpoint, keys of the wrong size, an unknown timezone, or an endpoint not on a public address (unless NOTIFICATIONS_ALLOW_PRIVATE)

409.description: the endpoint is another user's subscription, with other keys

delete.summary: Forgets a device's subscription (also when there was none).

post.summary: Sends a test notification to each of the user's devices.

get.summary: The key a device registers its Web Push endpoint with (VAPID).

post.summary: Adds a device waiting for approval by an active device (`approve_device` of `PUT /pgp/vault`).

400.description: plain text: invalid device credential

409.description: plain text: vault not initialized or device already registered

post.summary:
Adds or replaces a public key; answers the key as stored. Its trust follows its `source`: a key the user
imported is trusted, one found in mail (`harvested_…`) is stored `unverified`, and never changes a stored key
the user trusts or owns (the answer is then that key, unchanged). One sender's key is trusted for an address:
a trusted key for an address with another's trusted key is a key change, stored only with `replace`.

200.description: the key as stored

400.description: plain text: invalid public key, an unknown source, or an own key with a `harvested_…` source

409.description: `key_change`: another sender's key is trusted for the address (send `replace` once the user accepted the change)

204.description: deleted (also when there was no such key)

post.summary:
The user accepted a stored key (one found in mail, after seeing its fingerprint and user IDs): it is trusted for
the address it was stored for; with `replace` (a key change) it takes the place of the other senders' keys stored
for that address, without it a key change is a 409. Answers the key.

200.description: the key, now trusted

409.description: `key_change`: another sender's key is trusted for the address (send `replace` once the user accepted the change)

get.summary: The stored public keys, optionally of one address.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: only the keys of this address

get.summary: The user's vault, or 204 when none is initialized.

put.summary: Applies a change to the vault in one transaction if it is still at `expected_revision`.

400.description: plain text: invalid vault update (e.g. no such pending device)

delete.summary:
Deletes the whole vault: its manifest, the encrypted private keys, and the user's WebAuthn
credentials with their devices and wraps.

post.summary:
Creates the vault (revision 1) with its first key and first device (active, with its wrap);
the device's credential must be the user's.

400.description: plain text: invalid device credential

post.summary:
Webhook endpoint for WebDAV-Push notifications.
Validates the per-calendar token, then triggers an incremental sync.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: the push subscription's token (of a calendar or an address book)

201.description: accepted (also for an unknown token, so tokens cannot be probed)

400.description: missing token (plain text)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: the search text (at most 200 characters are used)

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: earliest start, `YYYY-MM-DD`

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: latest start, `YYYY-MM-DD`

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: `1`: only the active calendars (when no `cal` is given)

parameters.name: cal
parameters.description: calendars to search, each `account_id` and `href` joined by NUL or `|` (default: all)

200.description: at most 100 events, latest first

400.description: no search text (plain text)

post.summary: Saves the single CalDAV login after testing it; an empty password keeps the stored one.

get.summary: The signed-in user; starts the user's sync task.

post.summary:
Finishes the passkey authentication started in the session and updates the credential's
counter: the credential that was used.

400.description: plain text: no authentication in progress or invalid credential

post.summary:
Starts a passkey authentication with the user's credentials: the challenge to pass to
`navigator.credentials.get()`, evaluating the `prf` extension with `prf_salt`. The state is kept
in the session for `/webauthn/authenticate/finish`.

200.description: WebAuthn `RequestChallengeResponse` (`{ publicKey: PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions }`), its `extensions` set to `{ prf: { eval: { first: prf_salt } } }`

500.description: plain text: database, WebAuthn or session error

delete.summary: Deletes one of the user's WebAuthn credentials (with its vault device and wrap).

204.description: deleted (also when there was no such credential)

get.summary: The signed-in user's WebAuthn credentials.

post.summary: Finishes the passkey registration started in the session and stores the credential.

400.description: plain text: no registration in progress, invalid credential or registration failed

post.summary:
Starts a passkey registration for the signed-in user (excluding the credentials already
enrolled): the challenge to pass to `navigator.credentials.create()`. The registration state is
kept in the session for `/webauthn/register/finish`.

200.description: WebAuthn `CreationChallengeResponse` (`{ publicKey: PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions }`), with a required resident key and the `prf` extension requested

500.description: plain text: WebAuthn or session error

replace.description: a key change the user accepted: the other senders' keys stored for the same address are removed (default false)

Account.description: A mail account, IMAP or JMAP (its password is never sent).

jmap_url.description: a JMAP account's session URL; `null` for IMAP

auth.description:
how a JMAP account signs in: `password`, `bearer` (an API token), `oidc` (the user's OIDC sign-in) or
`oauth` (the server's own sign-in); `password` for IMAP

oauth_client_id.description: `oauth`: the OAuth client the server has for Caley (its secret is never sent)

host.description: IMAP server (JMAP: the host of its URL)

AccountAuth.description: How a JMAP account signs in.

AccountBody.description: A mail account to add (no `account_id`) or update.

jmap_url.description: JMAP: the session URL, or the server's host (`https://host/.well-known/jmap`)

oneOf.description: JMAP: how it signs in, default `password`

host.description: IMAP server (ignored for JMAP: taken from its URL)

password.description: empty or missing: keep the stored one (required for a new account, unless it signs in with OIDC)

sender_name.description: a new account's default identity gets this name (none without it)

oauth_client_id.description: `oauth`: the OAuth client the server has for Caley

oauth_client_secret.description: its secret; empty or missing: keep the stored one (none for a public client)

authorize.description: `oauth`: sign in at the server again (a new account, or one on another server or client, always does)

AccountDeleted.description: The account was deleted and the session ended.

redirect.description: where to go next: always `/`, the login page

authorize.description:
an account that signs in at the server (`oauth`) and is to be authorized there: not saved yet, the page goes
to this link (Caley's, which redirects to the server's sign-in; the account is saved when it comes back)

AddrSuggestions.description: Addresses seen in the user's mail that contain the query.

AlarmFields.description: An alarm as the event form edits it.

value.description: the amount of `unit`s (relative alarms; empty for absolute ones)

unit.description: minutes per unit: `1`, `60` or `1440` (empty for absolute alarms)

datetime.description: UTC, `YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ` (absolute alarms; empty for relative ones)

ApiError.description: An error the API explains: `{"error": "..."}` (4xx; a 5xx is plain text).

ApproveDeviceBody.description: A pending device made active, with the vault key wrapped for it.

Attachment.description: An attachment of a message (GET /email/attachment downloads it).

content_id.description: the Content-ID of an inline part (`cid:` images)

demo_mode.description: whether this is the demo (`DEMO_MODE`): it signs in without credentials, `POST /auth/login`

prf_salt.description: the salt for the `prf` extension's `eval.first`, base64url

credential_id.description: only this credential (base64url ID) is allowed; all the user's credentials without it

Autodiscovery.description:
What autodiscovery found for an address: `{"found": false}`, or `found` with all the IMAP and SMTP
servers' fields (`provider_name` may be `null`); `jmap_url` when the domain has a JMAP server (found
or not).

Binary.description:
Raw bytes: a binary response (an image, a file), `type: string, format: binary`.
(`Vec<u8>` would be described as an array of integers.)

BulkFlagsBody.description: Sets or clears flags on several messages.

set.description: true adds the flags, false removes them

BulkMoveBody.description: Moves several messages, each to its `dest_mailbox`.

BulkResult.description: What a bulk change could not do: the messages whose account does not exist (the others were changed).

CalDavAccountJson.description: A CalDAV account with its cached calendars and address books.

has_password.description: always true: a saved account has a password (it is never sent)

photo_rev.description:
Version of the photo (a hash of it), sent as `v` with the photo URL so the browser may keep the photo
until it changes. None when there is no photo GET /api/contact/photo would serve.

ContactsResponse.description: All address books and contacts of the user.

color.description: CSS color; empty or missing for none

cred_id.description: the credential ID, base64url without padding

has_prf.description: whether the credential supports the `prf` extension (needed to unlock the vault)

DayEventsJson.description: A day of the week view with its events, all-day ones first.

DeviceBundle.description:
A device's public key material and its own private key encrypted with its passkey's PRF output
(opaque to the server).

public_jwk.description: the device's public ECDH key, a JWK

encrypted_private_jwk.description: the device's private JWK, encrypted with its PRF-derived key

DeviceRecord.description: A device of the vault, as stored: its bundle, status and wrap.

status.description: `pending` (waiting for approval by an active device) or `active`

public_jwk.description: the device's public ECDH key, a JWK (null if the stored one could not be read)

oneOf.description: the vault key wrapped for this device; null for a pending one

EmptyTrashBody.description: Deletes the messages of a trash mailbox put there more than `days` ago.

EncryptedBlob.description:
An opaque AES-GCM ciphertext encrypted in the browser (the vault manifest); the server cannot
decrypt it.

EventForm.description:
An event to create (no `uid`) or save. The alarm and attendee fields repeat, once
per alarm / attendee, in the same order. Empty optional fields count as missing.

original_tz.description: the timezone the recurring master was authored in (default `tz`)

original_calendar_href.description: the calendar the event was in, when it moves

original_account_id.description: the account the event was in, when it moves

recurrence.description: `RecurrenceInfo` as JSON; empty or `{}` for none

attendee_email.description: an attendee without an address is left out

EventJson.description: An event (one occurrence of a recurring one), times in the viewer's timezone.

color.description: the calendar's color, or a CSS variable for calendars without one

EventScope.description: What an event write applies to.

FlagsBody.description: Sets or clears IMAP flags on a message.

set.description: true adds the flags, false removes them

Identity.description: A sender identity (name and address) of an account.

IdentityBody.description: A sender identity to add (no `identity_id`) or update.

origin.description: an http(s) URL; stored as its `scheme://host`

ImageOrigins.description: A list of image origins (`scheme://host`): the allowed ones or the ignored ones.

ImportForm.description:
An ICS file to import into a calendar: an existing one (`calendar_href`) or a new one of the
account (`new_calendar_name`). The `email_*` fields name the message it came from, so the
message shows the events and the events their source message.

new_calendar_name.description: without `calendar_href`: the name of a calendar to create for the import

ImportPreviewEvent.description: An event of an ICS file, before the import.

account_id.description: the calendar the events went to (a new one for `new_calendar_name`)

Mailbox.description: An IMAP mailbox of an account.

delimiter.description: the hierarchy delimiter (`/`, `.`), `null` for a flat namespace

Message.description: A message, as the list, search and the message endpoint send it.

rowid.description: the cache row; with `sent_at` the list's keyset cursor

from_address.description:
the sender's address (lowercased): the From header's single mailbox, read from the cached source; null when
From has no mailbox or more than one, or the source is not cached. What a sender's keys are bound to, never
`from`. GET /email/message only; null in lists

body_cached.description:
whether the body was cached (GET /email/message only; false in lists). The reader reads the body from the
message's source (`/email/message/raw`).

MessageEventGroupJson.description: A message of a thread and the events imported from it.

MessageRef.description: A message: its account, mailbox and UID.

MessagesResponse.description: A page of messages (list rows: no body, no attachments).

total.description: the number of messages in the mailbox or folder

MonthDayJson.description: A cell of the month grid.

event_colors.description: the distinct colors of the day's events

MonthGridJson.description: A month as whole weeks (Monday first).

MoveMessageBody.description: Moves a message to another mailbox of its account.

PrivateKeyBlob.description:
An OpenPGP private key of the vault, encrypted in the browser with the vault key (opaque to
the server). The frontend's `VaultKeyRecord`.

ciphertext.description: the encrypted armored private key, base64url

has_prf.description: whether the authenticator reported the `prf` extension as enabled (default false)

SaveContactRequest.description: A contact to create (no `uid`) or update.

uid.description: the contact to update; none creates one

source.description:
default `imported`; `harvested_autocrypt` and `harvested_attachment` (found in mail, not chosen by the user)
store the key `unverified`

replace.description:
a key change the user saw and accepted: a trusted key for an address another sender's key is trusted for
takes its place (the others stored for the address are removed). Without it such a key is a 409 (default false)

has_more.description: whether there are more results past this page, in the direction asked for

SendRawForm.description: The multipart form of a raw send.

identity_id.description:
the identity to send as: its account's SMTP server, its address the envelope sender
(must be the message's only From)

envelope_to.description: JSON array of the envelope's To addresses

envelope_cc.description: JSON array of the envelope's Cc addresses

envelope_bcc.description: JSON array of the envelope's Bcc addresses

raw_mime.description: the message (`message/rfc822`): ASCII only, no Bcc header

SettingsFormJson.description: The single CalDAV login of the settings form (the first account).

SourceEmailJson.description: A mail message an event was imported from.

StatusOk.description: A write that has nothing else to say: `{"status": "ok"}`.

StoredPublicKey.description:
A stored OpenPGP public key: the user's own, a sender's the user trusts, or one found in mail that waits to be
accepted.

email.description: the address it was stored for: the only one it is trusted for (signatures, encryption)

is_own.description: whether it is the public half of one of the user's own keys

trust.description: `trusted` (the user imported or accepted it) or `unverified` (found in mail: counts for nothing until accepted)

endpoint.description: the push endpoint (https), as the device's push service gave it

p256dh.description: the device's P-256 public key (RFC 8291), uncompressed, base64url

timezone.description: the device's timezone (IANA), which reminders of all-day and floating events are timed in; UTC if none

TestSent.description: How many devices a test notification went to.

parent_message_id.description: the message this one replies to (its Message-ID)

ThreadResponse.description: The conversation of a message, oldest first, one entry per Message-ID.

active.description: `false` hides the calendar, `true` (or missing) shows it

UnreadCounts.description: The unread messages per account and mailbox, and per virtual folder.

mailboxes.description: account id → mailbox name → unread count

UpdateVaultBody.description:
A change of the vault, applied only if the vault is still at `expected_revision`. The
frontend's `VaultUpdate`.

remove_device.description: a credential ID whose credential, device and wrap are deleted

User.description: The signed-in user (an OIDC or a demo session alike).

display_name.description: the name to show; the user ID when there is none

has_settings.description: whether a CalDAV account is set up

map_url.description: the map URL template for locations, `{q}` the query (`MAP_URL`)

oidc_signed_in.description: whether the user's OIDC sign-in is kept for mail accounts that sign in with it (JMAP)

logout_token.description: the session's logout token: `GET /logout?t=<token>` ends the session, nothing else does

VapidKey.description: The server's VAPID public key, which a device registers its Web Push endpoint with.

VaultData.description: The synced vault: opaque encrypted records and the devices' public material.

devices.description: in the order they were added

VaultRevision.description: The vault's revision after an update.

VaultWrap.description:
The vault key wrapped for one device (ECDH with an ephemeral key, then AES-GCM); opaque to the
server.

ephemeral_public_jwk.description: the ephemeral public ECDH key, a JWK (null if the stored one could not be read)

VirtualFolder.description: A virtual folder: the messages of the mailboxes its rules match.

VirtualFolderBody.description: A virtual folder to create (no `folder_id`) or update.

folder_id.description: the folder to update; absent or `null`: a new folder

VirtualFolderRule.description: Which mailboxes a virtual folder takes: `null` matches any account or mailbox.

VirtualFolderSaved.description: The id of the folder created or updated.

WebAuthnCredentialId.description: The WebAuthn credential a registration or an authentication ended with.

cred_id.description: the credential ID, base64url without padding
